text.tspan: Well-connected railway network linking major cities and tourist destinations.
State and private buses provide convenient travel across Tamil Nadu.
Major airports are available in Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai and Tiruchirappalli.
Local taxis and rental services are available for comfortable sightseeing.
Choose from budget stays to luxury hotels.
Relax in scenic hill, beach and heritage resorts.
Experience local hospitality and traditional living
